reference: Actual MuPDF get_texttrace Unicode/GID, glyf+hmtx+unitsPerEm font identity tolerant of metadata/cmap repacking, prepared cmap and nonempty embedded glyf outlines; original source GID outlines and hmtx. Full source traces independently guard prepared original-face cmaps.
limitations: Base14/CFF and unchanged original fonts not matching prepared TrueType assets are listed as uncovered and require the existing source/layout audit.
Native ligatures use multiple Unicode scalars per GID and require a sequence check separately.
Prepared original-face cmap characters not observed in source traces are not independently attested by MuPDF; original document maps or original base cmap provide their Unicode association.
